source.title: Superforecasting: The Art and Science of Prediction
source.copyright_note: This file tracks original project interpretations and implementations, not reproduced book text.

principles.name: precise_resolvable_questions
principles.signals_application: Every signal forecast requires target, probability or value, horizon, cutoff and scoring rule.
principles.polymarket_application: Every tracked market requires an independent project forecast and mechanical resolution rule.

principles.name: outside_view_and_base_rates
principles.signals_application: Compare signal output with base-rate-only and ensemble benchmarks.
principles.polymarket_application: Record a reference class before case-specific adjustment.

principles.name: decomposition
principles.signals_application: Break forecasts into causal drivers rather than relying on one narrative.
principles.polymarket_application: Decompose conditional-event probability, conditional outcome and expected magnitude.

principles.name: disconfirming_evidence
principles.signals_application: Preserve contradictory evidence and invalidation conditions.
principles.polymarket_application: Record the strongest case against the project's divergence from market odds.

principles.name: proportional_updates
principles.signals_application: Every confidence or forecast change requires timestamped evidence and delta.
principles.polymarket_application: Track project updates separately from market-price changes.

principles.name: scoring_and_calibration
principles.signals_application: Measure signal forecast improvement against frozen benchmarks overall and by regime.
principles.polymarket_application: Score project and market probabilities at resolution using Brier score.

principles.name: immutable_forecast_history
principles.signals_application: Prospective forecasts and updates remain append-only.
principles.polymarket_application: Never replace old project probabilities with revised values.

principles.name: postmortems
principles.signals_application: Classify whether failures came from signal, regime, timing, leakage, costs or forecast process.
principles.polymarket_application: Separate direction, timing, calibration and resolution-interpretation errors.

principles.name: diverse_judgment_aggregation
principles.signals_application: Compare independent model or analyst forecasts before ensemble aggregation.
principles.polymarket_application: Treat market odds as one forecast among several, not the unquestioned truth.

principles.name: continuous_process_learning
principles.signals_application: Review performance and process compliance by signal family and regime.
principles.polymarket_application: Review project-versus-market calibration and recurring error categories.

next_implementation_steps: Add a validator for required forecast fields.
Add automatic Brier scoring when binary markets resolve.
Create the first live forecast records from existing Signals and Polymarket questions.
